mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,response_code,response_json,expires_at FROM idempotency_records WHERE actor_id=#{actorId} AND method=#{method} AND path=#{path} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_records(actor_id,method,path,idempotency_key,request_hash,response_code,response_json,expires_at) VALUES(#{actorId},#{method},#{path},#{key},#{hash},0,NULL,#{expiresAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_records SET request_hash=#{hash},response_code=#{responseCode},response_json=#{responseJson},expires_at=#{expiresAt} WHERE actor_id=#{actorId} AND method=#{method} AND path=#{path} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
